_help: One entry per version, only what THAT version brings (never repeat older news). 1 to 5 short items; icon is one of: new, update, game, design, fix, speed, coins, security, sound, star. The version is app-release.json's base plus the Android workflow run number (the next run of 'Android app (APK)'); a version without an entry shows a short generic message.
